record.name: Sierra Leone
record.summary: No qualifying institute identified. The Ministry of Communication, Technology and Innovation announced in May 2026 that it is starting Sierra Leone's first national AI strategy with World Bank support, beginning with a readiness assessment.

partial.scope: Negative-status confidence, preserved query provenance, national/official-language search coverage and source-independence audit; this is not a full recheck of all record fields.

Reassessed negative confidence under the revised rule using saved research. The retrieved material does not sufficiently establish the national AI governance arrangements. No new search or full recheck.
Attempted preservation of cited source copies and checked saved-copy hashes; failures remain in source access notes. This source-evidence work is not a full factual recheck of the record.

Re-ran searches in English for a government-designated institute that evaluates advanced models, or a commitment, proposal or study naming one. No qualifying institute or commitment was identified; results described the strategy consultation and readiness assessment. Reviewed the ministry article as primary governance evidence. Raised confidence to medium under the status-confidence rule: recorded queries in English and a national or official language, and cited primary governance evidence consistent with no qualifying institute. Partial check; the last full-check date is unchanged.

searches.query: Sierra Leone AI safety institute government
Sierra Leone national AI strategy AI safety institute evaluation government 2026

check.language_note: English is an official language or an official language of national administration; it is a practical national search language for this check. Other national or official languages were not exhaustively searched. Some submitted strings contain site. rather than site:; these literal strings are preserved and are not treated as domain-restricted searches. Search source_ids identify registered source URLs matched in the retrieved result set, which may include irrelevant hits. An empty list means no registered source URL was matched, not that the web response was empty. The earlier audit used independent_source_ids for substantive corroboration; governance_source_ids, where present, identifies the selected primary governance evidence. The Sri Lankan Cabinet URL (negative-second-lk-2026) was an unrelated result in the Sierra Leone combined response; it supplies no Sierra Leone evidence. Preserved result batches, using 1-based positions in check.searches: SL-search = searches 1, 2 (en, en). Each multi-query batch has only a combined returned result set; its source_ids cannot be attributed to individual queries. Historical query dates are recorded as 17 October 2026 in the phase6 search-boundary ledger. On 24 October 2026 the record was searched again in English; the result links of each query were matched against registered sources in the same way.
check.independence_note: Historical audit under the superseded two-independent-sources rule: Two substantively independent evidence origins were not established. Multiple pages from one owner, mirrors, reports of the same underlying announcement and general regional coverage are not counted as independent corroboration.
check.governance_note: The communications ministry's May 2026 article says it is developing the first national AI strategy with the World Bank, starting from a readiness diagnostic. It describes no body to evaluate advanced models.

related_bodies.name: Ministry of Communication, Technology and Innovation (MoCTI)
related_bodies.role: It leads the readiness assessment and the planned AI strategy; it is not an evaluation body.

record.notes: MoCTI's May 2026 article was freshly retrieved with substantive ministry text confirming strategy development with the World Bank and a readiness diagnostic. An earlier retrieval returned gambling/spam content, so the dated snapshot matters. No qualifying body to evaluate advanced models was identified in this bounded review. English-language searches for a government-designated AI safety institute with a remit to evaluate advanced models included a separate search of gov.sl.

next_check.reason: Check whether the strategy is drafted and proposes an evaluation body.
